text:
marta: heads up — nightly eval flagged a weird quality regression on convo_prompts with q4_0opt-quant. lots of completions contain stray tokens that look like fragments of previous requests, not model hallucinations. wondering if this is a prefix-cache prefetch issue.

diego: saw the same pattern when I tried a local run. outputs show interleaved KV reads between two near-simultaneous requests. looks nondeterministic.

alex: can you paste the config / flags used for the runtime? narrow/broad batching + prefetch on?

marta: repro config snippet from nightly harness:
```
model: q4_0opt-quant
prefetch: true
batch_mode: narrow
max_inflight_prefetch: 8
kv_shards: 16
```
Logs show lines like:
```
kv_slot_id=42 tenant=org-123 request_id=1887654310 op=commit
kv_slot_id=42 tenant=org-456 request_id=1887654312 op=read
```
which implies slot 42 being reused before commit isolation.

nisha: fwiw we merged a prefetch queue change two days ago to reduce idle cycles across workers. that change made the prefetch queue shared across worker threads (instead of per-request queues) — could be a race on slot assignment. tagging eng-ml.

diego: quick repro steps I used:
```
# run two concurrent traces with short prefixes
python tools/replay_prefix.py --model q4_0opt-quant --trace ids.txt --concurrency 2
# inspect kv dumps in /tmp/kv-dumps/*
```
I can attach small dumps privately. mutation ordering clearly interleaves.

alex: immediate mitigation: set prefetch=false for nightly-lab or reduce max_inflight_prefetch to 1 for q4 variants. also consider pinning to non-quant model while we triage.

marta: going to flip prefetch=false for the nightly job and re-run. will open GH issue with logs + repro script.

deploy-bot: deploy started: update nightly-lab/runtime config prefetch=false by marta at 1887654336 :hammer_and_wrench:

nisha: thanks — I'll take the bug. plan: add a unit test that runs concurrent prefetch flows and assert per-request slot ownership, then patch prefetch queue to be per-request or add atomic slot tag.

marta: perfect. if anyone has quick ideas for minimal guard (slot tagging, request epoch) shout here. otherwise I'll track in the issue. :thumbsup:
